overview.title: Above the white roofs
overview.p1: Tetouan’s kasbah sits on higher ground, a reminder that this was once a fortified city as well as a craft centre. The climb is modest; the reward is perspective over the dense white medina and toward the Rif when the air is clear.
overview.p2: Come for the views and the quieter paths more than for a single ticketed monument. Combine with a medina morning so the ascent feels earned.
overview.p3: Wear shoes with grip. Midday sun on exposed sections is strong in summer — morning or late afternoon is kinder.

q1.question: Is there an entry fee?
q1.answer: Access to viewpoints and paths is generally open; respect any local or site rules posted on the day.

q2.question: How hard is the climb?
q2.answer: Moderate — short but steep in places. Not a mountain hike.

q3.question: Best time?
q3.answer: Morning or late afternoon for cooler air and better light.

q4.question: Combine with what?
q4.answer: Medina walk before or after; Place Hassan II as your start/end.

q5.question: Good for photos?
q5.answer: Yes — especially for wide medina frames you cannot get from the lanes.

food.title: Eat before or after the climb
food.p1: Bring water. Eat on Place Hassan II or in the medina rather than expecting full restaurants on the heights.
food.p2: A tea stop after you descend works better than carrying a heavy meal uphill.

1.title: Shoes matter
1.desc: Uneven paths and slopes — skip smooth sandals.

2.title: Time the light
2.desc: Late afternoon gives warmer tones on white walls; morning is cooler for walking.

3.title: Keep valuables simple
3.desc: Hands free for the climb; phone secured.
